answers.core: This is about improving the UX of developing internationalized user interfaces.
answers.workaround: This can be worked around with a script, but if you want to benefit from automatic translation (without including tags in the text given to translators), you need to use a script to concatenate the text and tags. For UI-centric scenes, this has the downside of requiring many one-off scripts.

title: Add a RichTextLabel property to always surround the text with a list of BBCode tags (for internationalization)
